(
SELECT  project_id,
        record,
        ifnull(INSTANCE,1) AS instance_id,
        group_concat(case when field_name in('topographycode') then VALUE ELSE null END) AS topographycode,
        ifnull(group_concat(case when field_name in('morphologycode') then VALUE ELSE null END),'') AS morphologycode,
        ifnull(group_concat(case when field_name in('laterality') then VALUE ELSE null END),'') AS laterality
FROM [data-table]
WHERE project_id = [project-id]
AND field_name in('topographycode','morphologycode', 'laterality')
AND record =  [record-name] 
GROUP BY record,[data-table].instance
)tmp
